cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
if(APPLE)
  project(third_party_deps LANGUAGES C CXX OBJC OBJCXX)
else()
  project(third_party_deps LANGUAGES C CXX)
endif()

# Install layout: libs/ headers+libraries, bin/ executables
set(CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
set(CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR "bin" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
set(CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR "libs/lib" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
set(CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR "libs/include" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
set(CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR "libs/share" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)

# ── GLFW ──
set(GLFW_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLFW_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLFW_BUILD_DOCS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLFW_INSTALL ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(glfw-3.4)

# ── MuJoCo ──
set(MUJOCO_BUILD_EXAMPLES ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MUJOCO_BUILD_SIMULATE ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MUJOCO_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MUJOCO_TEST_PYTHON_UTIL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MUJOCO_WITH_USD OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
# Use the GLFW we just built, don't fetch again
set(MUJOCO_SAMPLES_USE_SYSTEM_GLFW ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MUJOCO_SIMULATE_USE_SYSTEM_GLFW ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(mujoco-3.3.6)
